Help & FAQs.

Direct answers to the questions we hear most.

Answers

Cannot find what you need? Ask us.

What is OrgVia?

OrgVia is a web-based, multi-tenant HRMS covering employee records, org chart, attendance, leave, payroll workflows, recruitment, onboarding and performance.

How does employee attendance management work in OrgVia?

Employees clock in and out from their dashboard, which shows time worked today and the last action. Authorized users can see an attendance board and history, export CSV and make authorized corrections.

How do leave approval workflows work?

Leave types and balances are configured for the organization. An employee applies for leave; the approver reviews the request and approves or declines it. A calendar and summaries show who is away.

What HR operations does OrgVia support?

People and documents, org chart, attendance, leave, payroll configuration/runs/payslips, recruitment, onboarding, performance, compliance and support tickets. Modules are switched on per organization, so what you see depends on the setup agreed with your administrator.

Who is OrgVia suitable for?

Organizations that want employee records and HR workflows in one system, with different access for employees, managers, recruiters, HR and administrators.

Can we import our existing employee list?

Yes. The people section includes a CSV import as well as a form for adding employees one at a time.

Is each organization’s data separate?

OrgVia is multi-tenant: organizations work in their own workspaces, and platform administration is a separate console.

How can a company request an OrgVia demo?

Use the Book a demo form. The team replies to your work email.

What does OrgVia cost?

Pricing is agreed per organization. See Pricing.

Where do I log in?

Existing users sign in at orgvia-app.rishabh.codes.
